children: Voting on Trivolve Tech's PFMS treasury proposal closes on 20 November 2026. The proposal asks Cardano voters to approve a withdrawal of 9.6 million ADA from the Cardano treasury, subject to milestones.

PFMS is a government forensic system that already records evidence on-chain. The vote determines whether the project can move forward with a government-scale deployment funded by a relatively small withdrawal from the treasury.
The PFMS treasury proposal from Trivolve Tech closes in two days on 20 November.
DReps, read the proposal and the community discussion, then cast your vote.
Cardano’s governance works best with active participation. Every vote counts.

title: Cardano: Voting closes on the PFMS treasury proposal - 20 Nov 2026
